sentences.text:
Appearance:
 Shri Gyanendra Sharma - advocate for the petitioner.
Shri Surendra Gupta, learned GA for the State.
ORDER Heard and perused the record.

2. This is third bail application filed under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973), for grant of bail during trial relating to Crime No.339/2024 dated (not mentioned), registered at Police Station- Betma, District-Indore, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(h) of IPC, 1860 and Section 5/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 22.05.2024.
His earlier two bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn vide orders dtd 6.8.2024 and 13.9.2024.
3. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is of commission of rape with the prosecutrix.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present crime.
The age of the prosecutrix was 17 years and 11 months at the time of incident.
Statements of prosecutrix and her mother has been recorded wherein they have not supported the prosecution case and declared hostile.
The applicant is in custody since 22.05.2024.
Conclusion of trial will take NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-IND:32167 2 MCRC-44785-2024 sufficient long time.

Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail Jadu @ Jadhav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177213251/
1 to the applicant.

entities.text: Jadu @ Jadhav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned Govt. Advocate for the State has opposed the application and prays for its rejection.
6. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

7. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, the rival submissions of the counsel for the parties, custody period of the applicant, without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

8. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his/her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his/her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of BNSS.
9.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Certified Copy as per rules.
(PREM NARAYAN SINGH) JUDGE VD Jadu @ Jadhav vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177213251/
